response.info: Latest police, crime and accident news from Bild (Germany)
response.messages: Bild: A 34-year-old man was arrested in Berlin after a knife attack at Alexanderplatz; no fatalities reported. In Munich, police are investigating a series of car break-ins in the Schwabing district. A serious accident on the A3 near Cologne left two people injured and caused a temporary closure of the highway.

response.info: Latest police, crime and accident news from Der Spiegel (Germany)
response.messages: Der Spiegel: Federal police report a rise in cybercrime cases targeting online banking customers. A drug trafficking ring was dismantled in Hamburg, with five suspects taken into custody. In Stuttgart, a fire in an apartment building is being treated as possible arson; investigators are on site.
